title: Assign staff and start a walk-in service
summary: Check staff readiness, start the visit and complete checkout without losing queue history.

sections.title: Choose staff and start
sections.body:
1. Open **Walk-in queue** and find the waiting client.
2. Select the client’s **Serve** action to open their details.
3. Under **Choose staff**, select the intended person. ClipperDesk checks qualifications, hours, bookings and required resources.
4. If you only want to remember the choice, select **Save assignment**. Add **Reassignment note (optional)** when useful.
5. When the readiness check succeeds and the client is ready, select **Start service**.
6. Confirm the client moves to **In service**.

Saving an assignment reserves no time. Starting creates and links the real appointment and checks availability again.

sections.title: Complete the visit
sections.body:
Use **Complete** for a visit that has finished. The linked appointment and queue status stay in step. A completed walk-in may show **Checkout** for an authorized user; open it to review the sale and record money received.

Once an appointment has been created, use **Calendar** for rescheduling, reassignment or cancellation so the reserved time is handled correctly.

sections.title: If Start service is unavailable
sections.body:
Select an eligible person and read the readiness result. A stale check needs **Check again**. If a current service has passed its expected finish, resolve its actual status before starting another client on that person.

Wait estimates do not reserve resources or guarantee that a service fits. If the queue has not refreshed recently, refresh it before relying on estimates. After an interrupted change, check the current queue and Calendar before repeating the action.
